assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only chiramune:yuzuki-nanase@light-novel#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional generation V1.4 cumulative monograph CHIRAMUNE_YUZUKI_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese light novels: main Volumes 01-09 and the admitted narrative supplements it integrates (the V03 purchase-bonus booklet, the V05 special edition, V06.5, Days of Endless Summer and Volume 09.5). The V08 rough-illustration collection is excluded by the monograph as production paratext. The Chiramune readings, longitudinal ledgers, specialist syntheses, current-corpus synthesis and other character monographs that also analyze Yuzuki are not curated on this subject and were not used. The monograph's active_provisional status and its own current-model statements are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Base model at the V02 freeze (line-range locators), followed by located revisions for V03 main, the V03 booklet, V04, V05 main, the V05 special edition, V06, V06.5, V07, V08 main, V09, Days of Endless Summer and Volume 09.5, mostly with paragraph-range locators. V01 has no separate treatment, and the opening Scope paragraph still describes a V04-bounded model. Sections are not in reading order (V09 and Days of Endless Summer precede V08 main; V06.5 follows V08), so each current model is bound to its own boundary. Days of Endless Summer and Volume 09.5 add placed retrospective testimony; the boundary limits evidence, not knowledge, so placed memories belong to her at every state they predate. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A governing account (sections 1-4: an authored, plural self whose competence began as a practical answer to the social costs of visibility; optimization as style; jurisdiction over self, love and consent as the V02 acquisition), a stable-versus-state split (section 14) and five rejected rival readings (section 15). It says what changes her response: whether social calibration can still control the situation (talk and precision when it can; freeze, then the V02 procedural refusal, when force overrides it, p-0031:045-061, p-0032:100-135); whether someone recognizes the interface before she shows vulnerability (section 3); and whether a claim can be made finite and deniable or must be heard (V03B overwrite, V05 fireworks part0016 p0242-p0326, V07 resolve part0028 p0631-p0663). It predicts her mistakes as well as her care: cold accusation under cumulative fear (the Nazu accusation, p-0031:349-372), private absorption of complaints inside the hidden compact (V04 p-0023 to p-0025), the false cafe test of Momiji (V07 part0026), Nana's domination of teammates and the consent violation (V08 p-0013, p-0028), and precise but wrong forecasts about her own love (V05S p-0052, p-0074). It stops at whether released capacity coordinates or dominates after V09 in team play, at vocation and at any Saku answer.

Each revision ends in a bounded current model: V02 freeze (jurisdictional core begun), V03 main (named love as non-sabotaging movement, p-0022, p-0024), V03 booklet (overwrite; generosity is not neutrality), V04 (invisible management to public co-leadership, p-0023 to p-0032), V05 main (ladder from hypothetical request to bounded fireworks request), V05 special edition (first-year Haru partnership; theories falsified), V06 (pain contained with Haru; safe praise as distance; sauce katsudon, p-0012 to p-0033), V06.5 (chosen femininity, vocational question, Kanazawa pact, novel-meal request), V07 (meal fulfilled, Yua's place kept, false test, full-effort win, resolve), V08 main (Nana, consent violation, Saku's reciprocal words with a spring horizon), V09 (accountability, refusing to hate Momiji, mirrorhood as correction), Days of Endless Summer (placed retrospective testimony) and V09.5 (middle-school witness). Limits: V01 has no separate treatment; the opening Scope paragraph still calls this a V04-bounded model; sections are out of reading order (V09 and Days of Endless Summer precede V08 main, V06.5 follows V08); V02 locators are line ranges rather than paragraph IDs.

There is no voice or register section. The monograph records register-shift conditions and speech acts across states: polished speech used strategically and rawer directness with trusted people or under pressure (section 13); class, public and teammate modes she distinguishes herself (V05S p-0074 p0079-p0088); mock-criminal directions, claimed coincidence, sexual humor and deniable wording carrying a sincere bid (V03B p-001); a brief shift to Saku's given name (V04 p-0025 p0337-p0380); a sexual joke used as shared cover (V05 part0026); bounded explicit requests (V05, V06.5). Attested forms are few (overwrite, `Nana`, `いつか`, `優空用`). Pronouns, address inventory, sentence endings and per-dyad register are not described.

Section 13 gives a V02 ordinary-life profile (festival atmosphere and goldfish, vegetable salt ramen, spicy food, grooming routines, glasses and borrowed clothes, jealousy over indirect-intimacy details). Later states add how ordinary practice adapts to a recipient: domestic comparison with Yua (V05 part0010), sauce katsudon chosen to nourish Saku rather than perfect her image (V06 p-0022), the wardrobe as protection against the cost of visible femininity (V065 p-0011), the novel-meal request and its fulfilment, moving off Yua's chair and teaching Yua the recipe (V07 part0009, part0015, part0017), and the breakfast bid (DES p-0070). Home, family, schoolwork and solitary routine are not sampled.

Relations are differentiated and located, and the account says what each changes. Saku: a mistaken mirror whose breaking increases attraction (section 7), recognition as the precondition for vulnerability, a ladder of bids, mirrorhood as correction rather than flattery (V09 p-0022, p-0029), reciprocal words without selection (V08 p-0030). Haru: an independently primary partner before romance (V05S p-0074), the hidden compact, open co-leadership, pain contained together (V06 p-0012), a moving-partner problem (V08 p-0013, p-0015). Asuka: the non-uniqueness wound and knowingly helping Saku toward her. Yua: a differentiated place acknowledged, not attacked. Yuko and Nazuna: styling help, the Kanazawa ten-year pact (V065 p-0013, p-0017), Nazuna's witness (V095 p-0026, p-0030). Momiji: test, then direct rivalry without dehumanization (V09 p-0014, p-0020). Teammates: given a voice in V04, used as pieces in V08. Coercers (Yanagishita, Tomoya): jurisdiction refused. Transfer to an unsampled peer or adult is not established.

Direct Yuzuki focalization is located in V02 (the trauma-origin rejection and the fear of reorganizing herself around a coercer, p-0032:002-023), V05 special edition (romantic theories, mode distinctions), V06 (the private aside that she still cannot communicate fully, p-0022 p0341-p0342), V06.5 (wardrobe and vocation), V07 (the refuge of unused capacity and the unheard resolve, part0028) and the Days of Endless Summer testimony; these interior states causally drive located choices. The monograph also shows her introspection failing as prediction (V05S). V03, the V03 booklet and V09.5 add no focalization, and V08-V09 interior is largely given through conduct and apology.

Located responses fall into conditioned families: against force that defeats social tools, freeze in middle school and then exits, visibility, stated nonconsent and a plan to report once the V02 core forms (p-0032:100-135); under cumulative fear and harassment, cold accusation followed, once named wrong, by public apology without seeking absolution (p-0031:349-372); against a partner's failing method, private absorption until collapse, then eliciting teammates' voices and open co-leadership (V04 p-0023, p-0032); against a rival's strategy, a deceptive test in V07 and direct answerable confrontation in V09; against Saku betraying his own answer process, corrective confrontation (V09 p-0022 p1386-p1592); with released capacity, domination of a game and of a sexual encounter (V08 p-0013 p0497-p0794, p-0028 p0175-p0270), then responsibility. Conflict with adults other than Coach Misaki and post-V09 team conflict are not sampled.

Located positions with their corrections: bodily harm does not confer ownership (V02 p-0032:100-135); an apology names one's act without bargaining for friendship (p-0031:349-372); loyalty can include public disagreement, while delayed disclosure stays contestable (V04); competition without sabotage (V03, V05); refusing a rival's requested hatred (V09 p-0014); the V08 violation recognized as nonconsensual and answered by exact apology rather than self-contamination (V08 p-0028, V09 p-0025 p0053-p0084). Section 10's analysis of Saku's apartment method is the monograph's ethics, not hers. Weighing is seldom rendered, and dilemmas outside consent, rivalry and accountability are not sampled. The discovery row does not list ETHICS; graded as in the open PR's point 15.

Play is located with conditions for its function: sexual playfulness and directness when she feels safe (section 13); mock-criminal staging, claimed coincidence and sexual humor as the vehicle of a sincere but deniable bid that lets Saku answer only at the level of play (V03B p-001 p0015-p0056); a sexual joke as mutually legible cover that leaves jealousy undisclosed (V05 part0026 p0308-p0339); flattened safe praise breaking banter and banter resuming with acknowledged stakes (V06 p-0020, p-0033); arcade air hockey as precision against Haru's attack (section 4). Joke content and style are not analyzed, and what switches play to seriousness outside the Saku dyad is not stated.

One cumulative generation V1.4 monograph covers main V01-V09 and the admitted supplements through Volume 09.5 (V03 booklet, V05 special edition, V06.5, Days of Endless Summer, V09.5), excluding the V08 rough-illustration collection as production paratext. Most claims from V03 on carry paragraph-range locators. Gaps: V01 is not treated separately, the Scope paragraph is internally stale (V04-bounded), sections are out of reading order, there is no voice section, and the item is active_provisional. The readings, ledgers and syntheses that also analyze Yuzuki are not curated on this subject.

Affirmative limits are located: her own chronology contradicts the trauma-compensation reading (p-0032:002-013); V02 is a state transition, not a cure, and V03 leaves the anti-coercion core untested; gratitude for Saku's reenactment is not prospective consent (section 10); her romantic theories are falsified by later named love (V05S); Saku's V05 jealousy is Saku-side evidence, not her bid; no selection or couple forms at any boundary (V08 asks time until spring, V09 is acting-only, the epilogue is prospective); the V08 consent violation stays in the model; one middle-school tournament chain is not rank (V095 p-0026 p0208-p0224). All rest on one secondary artifact.

Each revision binds a named current model to its boundary, and the monograph separates placed retrospective material (V05 special edition first-year autumn, Days of Endless Summer stories by placement, V09.5 middle school) from current transition, with instructions to place before revising. Located intra-volume changes (V02 before and after the core forms; V04 before and after Haru's collapse; V07 before and after the one-on-one; V08 Nana before and after the refusal) can be separated. A reader must reorder the sections and discount the stale Scope paragraph.

scenario_readiness.note: The evidence describes when her register shifts and what her speech acts do, not how she speaks: pronouns, address, endings and per-dyad forms are absent and attested forms are few. Generated lines would carry the right moves in an unconstrained voice, which does not constrain output enough even for illustrative use. This bounds the evidence set, not Yuzuki's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named boundary state: V02 before or after the core forms, V03 main, V03 booklet, V04 before or after Haru's collapse, V05 main (before the refusal), V06, V06.5, V07 before or after the one-on-one, V08 Nana before or after the refusal, or post-V09 (default, including Days of Endless Summer and V09.5 history). Earlier states do not import later corrections; placed retrospective memories belong to her at every state they predate.

The interlocutor is Saku, Haru, Asuka, Yua, Yuko, Nazuna, Momiji, Coach Misaki, Mai or the Fujishi teammates as located. Transfer to an unsampled peer or adult is a separate, lower-confidence condition handled without invented history.
The situation is a romantic bid or rivalry, a threat to her jurisdiction, accountability after her own wrong, team method or a basketball contest, or recipient-directed ordinary care.
Whether released capacity coordinates or dominates in post-V09 team play, any basketball vocation, a present dating request and any Saku answer are output as open forks, never resolved.
Output is behavioral description, not quoted dialogue.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named monograph boundary state, defaulting to post-V09 with Days of Endless Summer and V09.5 as placed history; earlier states only when selected, without later development.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Saku as recognized mirror, bid recipient and reciprocal but unselecting partner after V08; Haru as independently primary partner and rival; Asuka, Yua, Yuko and Momiji as rivals or friends with located places; Nazuna as witness and friend; teammates and Coach Misaki at located team states; an unsampled peer only at lower confidence.

scenario_readiness.note: Readiness is conditional on one named state, a sampled relationship and the peer, romantic, school-sport and domestic settings the monograph locates. Team play after V09, vocation and any Saku answer stay open.

known_limits.statement: At every boundary through V09.5 Saku's answer stays unselected: V08 reciprocal words come with a request for time until next spring, the V09 stage choice is for that stage only and the epilogue is prospective. No exclusivity, lip kiss or couple forms.

In V08 she escalated sexual contact past a verbal limit and read his bodily response as consent; she recognized it as nonconsensual. Reciprocity and V09 repair neither authorize nor erase it, and it must remain in the model.
Her own chronology places the self-fashioned persona before the Yanagishita incident; a trauma-compensation account of her personality is contradicted and must not be used.
V02 records a state transition, not a cure; V03 leaves the anti-coercion core untested, and later volumes do not retest it outside the V02 frame.

Her pre-love theories that similarity guarantees a calm relation and that people choose what they lack are falsified by her later named love; her introspection is evidence of her reasoning, not a reliable forecast.
After V08 no section samples team reconstruction, and basketball has no educational, institutional or vocational logistics through V09.5; one tournament chain and one practice win are not rank.
Her gratitude for Saku's apartment reenactment is evidence about her interpretation, not prospective consent to the method or a general ethical warrant.
No pronoun, address, sentence-ending or per-dyad register analysis exists in this evidence set beyond register-shift conditions and a few attested forms.
Home, family, schoolwork and solitary leisure are not sampled in this evidence set.

The evidence is one active_provisional generation V1.4 monograph with V01 untreated, a stale Scope paragraph and sections out of reading order; no reading, ledger, synthesis or held-out validation is curated on this subject. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
